raw.rationale: Osthol is a weakly cytotoxic coumarin with calcium-channel-blocking and anti-proliferative activity, but no lineage-selective dependency or transporter biomarker is known; PRISM single-point data for such compounds typically show only sporadic, low-magnitude lineage effects. Therefore probabilities are kept near the upper end of the stated base rate for lineages with possible broad sensitivity and near the lower end for others.
